text:
maya: quick sync — prepping phoenix-7b-v2 AWQ canary. need fast checks: weights location, tokenizer quirks, calib dataset size, and fp8 fallback plan. hoping to start canary tomorrow morning.

alex: weights uploaded -> s3://redwood-models/phoenix/7b/v2/weights-awq/sha=4f2d9a8. also pushed weights-meta.json with sha+shape+dtype.

leah: tokenizer note: a few checkpoints missing BOS token which shifts generation. set `add_bos=True` in tokenizer config or run quick patch. sample: ```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('phoenix/tokenizer-v2')
t.add_bos_token = True  # important for this ckpt
```

sam: calib dataset prepared — 2.5k records (60% convo, 30% docs, 10% short prompts). includes recent user prompts and edge cases from reg-suite. is 2.5k ok or want to trim to 2k?

maya: 2k was the original target but 2.5k is fine for more stable stats. goal: keep eval variance low. target P95 latency for canary = 120ms.

ben: proposed canary plan: start 1 GPU pool, 5% traffic for 2h, check eval metrics & infra. quick config:```yaml
canary:
  traffic: 0.05
  duration: 2h
  checks:
    - eval_perplexity
    - topk_accuracy
    - token_latency_p95
    - mem_usage_pct
```
If metrics pass (perp delta <= 1.5% and p95 < 120ms) then escalate to 20%.

deploy-bot: staging deploy initiated for phoenix-7b-v2-awq (canary id=c-9876) — logs streaming: https://ci.internal/jobs/c-9876

alex: FP8 note: FP8 path added as opt-in. not wired for kv-cache quantization yet — so fallback path will be AWQ/GPTQ 4-bit in case of issues. also added a flag `serve.quant_fallback: true`.

leah: approval rubric: ok to canary if calibration shows <=1.5% accuracy drop vs fp16 on reg-suite and no new tokenization errors. +1 from me :thumbsup:

maya: @sam can you run the calibration job and paste the job link? include seed+sampling config.

sam: kicked off calib job -> https://jobs.internal/run/12345 (seed=42, sample_strategy=diverse, n_samples=2500). ETA ~45m.

ben: I'll wire up infra alerts — will shout if memory > 90% or GPU oom events.

maya: thanks everyone. will hold off canary final start until calib outputs land. cc @security for key handling (weights s3 are in restricted bucket).

leah: quick follow-up — tokenizer patch merged in #4567, please pull latest before running evals.

alex: noted — also added a small script to convert legacy tokenizer specials: `tools/tokenizer/normalize_specials.sh`.

sam: job finished (success). summary: perp delta=1.2%, p95=110ms, no mem spikes. full artifacts: https://jobs.internal/artifacts/12345

maya: great — based on this, moving forward with canary start tomorrow at 09:00 PT. thanks all for fast turnaround :rocket:
